description: Registers a promoted G4 flow-template capability as a discoverable, callable tool. Accepts a full G4 plugin manifest (the same shape produced by the flow-to-template promotion pipeline) and persists it through the G4 engine's Templates store.

manifest.description: The full G4 plugin manifest describing the capability to register, matching the G4PluginAttribute JSON shape (key, pluginType, source, summary, description, parameters, properties, rules, context, etc.) — the same manifest shape accepted by PUT /api/v4/g4/templates.

name: g4.RegisterCapability

key.description: The unique key of the registered capability, taken from the submitted manifest.

pluginType.description: The plugin type assigned to the registered manifest by the engine. Always "Action" after registration, regardless of what was submitted.

registered.description: Indicates whether the manifest was successfully registered as a template.

source.description: The normalized source of the registered manifest. Always "Template" for capabilities registered through this tool.

title: Register G4 Capability
